candidates.title: Pick Friend Two Column Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the pet selection screen with a two-column layout to present companion choices side-by-side with personality traits and stats.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 69.6% with a median time of 89s. Presenting comparative information side-by-side streamlines decision making.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of the pick_friend selection screen layout within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has the highest drop-off rate (30.4%), but adoption redesigns have consistently lost conversion (-3.1% over 3 tests).

candidates.title: Move Sign-In After Home Intro Screen
candidates.change: Move the sign_in step to occur after home_intro so users experience their interactive desktop pet before account setup.
candidates.why: Lessons show reordering sign-in was effective in multiple winning tests. Pushing authentication after users see their pet working reduces early drop-off.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Story Scroll Flow
candidates.change: Introduce a dynamic story scroll layout on the pet selection screen that reveals pet lore as users scroll through available options.
candidates.why: Adoption drop-off is high (30.4%). Interactive story scrolling keeps users engaged while evaluating pet options.

guard.reason: Valid layout redesign for the pet selection screen that retains its core job.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step drops 30.4% of users, and new flow implementations in adoption have strong historical backing (+1.7% across 4 tests).

candidates.title: Choose Path Journey Welcome Screen
candidates.change: Insert a new introductory screen right after story to set expectations for custom versus preset companion creation paths.
candidates.why: Choose path step takes a long mean time of 514s and loses 21.5% of users; introducing a welcome transition clarifies the available adoption routes.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Video Preview Flow
candidates.change: Display an animated video preview of the pet exploring the desktop while generation progress completes on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a long mean duration of 2336s. Providing visual feedback of desktop activity maintains user engagement.

guard.reason: Adding a video preview component to the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long home step duration, and home wait_info changes show steady positive results (+0.9% across 4 tests).

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Checklist Layout Refresh
candidates.change: Update the adoption certificate screen to a checklist layout displaying verified pet setup details and adoption parameters.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the highest drop-off rate (30.4%). Clear confirmation layout builds confidence before pet generation starts.

guard.reason: Replacing the adoption certificate with a checklist layout removes the required official stamp showing the adoption.

candidates.title: Home Intro Spotlight Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the home intro screen layout to a spotlight layout that highlights desktop launch controls and completion buttons.
candidates.why: Finish step has a 28.6% drop-off and very high mean duration (5815s). A spotlight layout focuses user attention directly on launching the pet.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of the home_intro spotlight layout within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has high drop-off (28.6%), but layout redesigns and finish screen overhauls historically hurt performance.

candidates.title: Story Screen Two Column Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the initial story screen layout to a two-column view presenting the pet companion welcome narrative side-by-side with app features.
candidates.why: Choose path step layout updates have previously improved funnel progression; a structured two-column presentation improves readability.

guard.reason: Valid two-column layout redesign for the story screen.

candidates.score_note: Choose path drops 21.5% of users, and choose_path layout changes have succeeded in 2 winning tests (+1.3% average).

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Desktop Ready Alert
candidates.change: Add an explicit notify toggle and completion status badge to the waiting screen so users know when background generation completes.
candidates.why: The home/waiting step takes mean 2336s. Notifications keep users informed when pet generation finishes while they use other apps.

guard.reason: Adding notification controls and status badges to the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Targeted step drop-off is lower (15.6%); single prior test shows slight positive (+0.8%) but pattern is unconfirmed.

candidates.title: Home Intro Desktop Active Status Display
candidates.change: Add a desktop status indicator badge and explanatory hint text on the home intro screen confirming the pet is running in the system tray.
candidates.why: Support emails show users confused about pet visibility on desktop ('Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open').

home_intro.hint: Your pet is active in your system tray. Click its icon anytime to reveal or customize it.

guard.reason: Adding status indicators and hint text to home_intro is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Strongest evidence across both funnel and support mail, but finish hints have historically shown 0.0% lift across tests.
